fields.description: Paste a Google Maps link to automatically extract coordinates.
fields.label: Google Maps Link

fields.description: When an On the Way technician is within this distance of the customer GPS coordinates, the request changes automatically to Delivered.
fields.label: Arrival Radius (meters)

fields.description: Distance at which the geographic-proximity score becomes zero.
fields.label: Proximity Score Distance (km)

fields.description: Open-request count at which the workload-balance score becomes zero.
fields.label: Maximum Open Requests per Technician

fields.description: Distance at which the route-suitability score becomes zero.
fields.label: Route Suitability Distance (km)

fields.description: Number of days used to calculate the technician completion-rate score.
fields.label: Completion Rate Lookback (days)

fields.description: Baseline used in scoring for a technician without requests in the completion-rate lookback period.
fields.label: New Technician Completion Rate (%)

fields.description: Enable incoming WhatsApp chatbot order ingestion. When enabled, the service fee, company, and warehouse below are mandatory and validated before saving.
fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Order Ingestion

fields.description: If checked, Sales Orders created via WhatsApp are submitted immediately (docstatus=1). If unchecked, they are created as Drafts (docstatus=0).
fields.label: Auto-Submit WhatsApp Sales Orders

fields.description: Action when a WhatsApp number is not found in ERPNext Customer database.
fields.label: Unknown Contact Action

fields.description: Default Item used for a WhatsApp service-visit order when the incoming payload does not provide an item code.
fields.label: Default Service Item

fields.description: Default service-visit fee applied when the incoming WhatsApp payload does not provide an item rate. Must be greater than zero when WhatsApp ingestion is enabled.
fields.label: Default Service Visit Fee

fields.description: Default Price List to apply for WhatsApp orders.
fields.label: Default Price List

fields.description: Default Warehouse for fulfillment of WhatsApp orders. It must be an enabled, non-group warehouse belonging to the configured company.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Default Company for WhatsApp Sales Orders. The selected warehouse must belong to this company.
fields.label: Default Company

fields.description: Default Currency for WhatsApp Sales Orders.
fields.label: Default Currency

fields.description: Comma-separated confirmation words accepted by the WhatsApp bridge after the LEAD_COMPLETION summary.
fields.label: WhatsApp Confirmation Keywords

fields.description: When enabled, active technicians send GPS updates while an active service request is assigned.
fields.label: Enable Background Location Tracking

fields.description: How often active technicians send a background GPS update. Use a value from 1 to 60 minutes.
fields.label: Location Update Interval (minutes)

fields.description: An assigned request older than this without technician acceptance is flagged in the operations-health report.
fields.label: Technician Response Timeout (minutes)

fields.description: The queue depth at which the operations-health report marks a queue as requiring attention.
fields.label: Queue Backlog Warning Threshold

fields.description: An active technician location ping older than this is flagged as stale in the operations-health report.
fields.label: Tracking Stale After (minutes)
